s: Din tzoat qatan ubo g' seipim: qatan sheyyakol leekol kezayit dagan shehem h' mine tebua shetztzoat minim ellu masrachat, apillu eno yakol leoklo ella al yede bishshul kegon dayysa vekayyotze bah, im en tzarik lishhot mittechillat kezayit zeh ad sopo yoter mimmah sheggadol benoni shoheh baakilat peras mimmaakal zeh — tzarik leharchiq mitztzoato umimme raglayv kemo mishshel gadol. Abal im tzarik lishhot yoter mikkan — hare zeh keokel akshav chatzi zayit ulemachar chatzi zayit, shekken halaka lemosheh missinay sheen akila mitztarepet lishhiyya arukka kazo. Veshiur kazzayit yitbaer besiman tp"v, veshiur peras besiman try"b:

Veim haqqatan hu challash veeno yakol leekol kezzayit bikde akilat peras, ap al pi shehiggia leshanim sheacher kayyotze bo yakol leekol — en tzarik leharchiq mitztzoato umimme raglayv apillu hu ben g' vd' shanim (vehu sheadayin lo haya yakol leekol miyyamayv kezayit dagan bikde akilat peras). Abal im haya yakol leekol paam achat veachar kak nechelash veeno yakol — dino kegadol shetztzarik leharchiq mitztzoato umimme raglayv (vaapillu eno yakol). Vaapillu lo akal dagan miyyamim rabbim, vaapillu lo akal meolam, sheap shetztzoa zo enah middagan mikkol maqom (kol shehaya yakol leekol kezayit dagan bikde akilat peras) — bene meayim masrichim kol mine maakal sheyyokal. Vekol zeh min haddin abal tob veyashar liqrot ulehitpallel bemaqom shehu naqi legamre apillu mitztzoat tinoq ben yomo (im epshar beqqal, ap al pi sheen issur baddabar):

Im haya omed betpilla veraa tzoa kenegdo barichuq d' ammot (veeno yakol lachazor panayv mimmenna mippene shetztzarik lehachazir panayv keneged bet qodshe qadashim) — yelek lepanayv kede sheyyizreqenna meacharayv d' ammot. Veim i epshar kegon sheyyesh lepanayv nahar o dabar acher hamakkeb — yelek bikde sheyyannichenna litzdadim d' ammot. Veken biqriat shema, im i epshar lo. Veeno tzarik lachazor ella lemaqom sheppasaq velo lerosh hattepilla o haqqeriat shema, ap al pi shehitpallel veqara keneged hatztzoa, lepi sheen zeh "zebach reshaim toeba", kevan shello hayeta d' ammot sebibo, shebbahen lebaddam hu shemmechuyyab libdoq shello tehe bahem tzoa im hu maqom sherauy lehistappeq betzoa, veim lo badaq bahen poshea hu utepillato toeba, abal lo hitrichu libdoq lepanayv kimlo enayv ap al pi shehu bemaqom harauy lehistappeq bo betzoa:
